heading: What is OpenLake
content:
OpenLake is the open-source society of IIT Bhilai. It builds software the
campus actually uses, teaches students to make their first contribution, and
helps them contribute to open source elsewhere. Its tagline is
"Build. Learn. Contribute."

heading: Who can join OpenLake
content:
Anyone, from any batch or branch. Activities are public and free to join, and
no prior knowledge is needed to start.

heading: Do I need experience to join
content:
No. The workshops are aimed at people who have never opened a pull request,
and there are no prerequisites.

heading: Is there a fee to join
content:
No. There is no fee and no application. Join the Discord, come to a workshop,
or open an issue on any of the repositories.

heading: How do I join OpenLake
content:
There is no application process. Join the community Discord, attend a
workshop, or open an issue on any OpenLake repository.

heading: How do I make my first contribution
content:
Four steps: attend a workshop, pick a beginner-friendly issue in an OpenLake
repository and get a maintainer's review on your pull request, join a mentored
programme like FOSS Overflow or DevLabs, then contribute to outside programmes.

heading: What does OpenLake actually do
content:
Three stages, in order. Build: maintain campus software that has real users
and code review. Learn: free hands-on workshops on Git, Linux, web and app
development. Contribute: help members land contributions in the wider
open-source world.

heading: Why does OpenLake review pull requests
content:
Because a maintainer's review is the point of the beginner route. OpenLake
also says members should not stay confined to its own repositories, and that
the software should be real and used rather than practice exercises.

heading: How many projects does OpenLake have
content:
62 public repositories, 50 or more workshops and programmes run, and 9 GSoC
contributors whose proposals were accepted.

heading: How many people got into GSoC
content:
Nine contributors have had GSoC proposals accepted, five of them in 2023.
Members have also contributed to the Zowe Client Java SDK through an Open
Mainframe Project mentorship.

heading: What is FOSS Overflow
content:
FOSS Overflow is IIT Bhilai's annual open-source programme, a month-long
mentored hackathon. The January 2026 edition was described as India's largest
open-source hackathon.

heading: What is DevLabs
content:
DevLabs is a month-long mentored programme, listed alongside FOSS Overflow as
the step after your first reviewed pull request.

heading: What outside programmes does OpenLake point to
content: Google Summer of Code, LFX Mentorship, Outreachy and C4GT.

heading: Where can I see the code
content: All OpenLake projects are on GitHub at github.com/OpenLake.

heading: How do I contact OpenLake
content: Email openlake@iitbhilai.ac.in, or join the community Discord.

heading: Where is the OpenLake Discord
content:
The community Discord is at discord.gg/A2J9z92qzd. It is the main place to
ask questions and get started.

heading: Where is OpenLake on social media
content:
GitHub: github.com/OpenLake. Instagram: @openlake_iitbhilai. LinkedIn:
linkedin.com/company/openlake. X: @OpenLakeClub. YouTube: @openlakeiitbhilai1724.

heading: What campus tools does OpenLake build
content:
Student_Database_COSA manages student data and Positions of Responsibility.
Campus-Marketplace lets students buy and sell on campus. RateMyCourse collects
course and instructor reviews. Smart-Insti-App gathers institute information
and updates. RideShare handles ridesharing for students and staff.

heading: What tools are there for coursework
content:
iitbh-cgpa is a browser extension that calculates CGPA from the AIMS Portal.
iitbh-calendar generates a calendar for IIT Bhilai courses. Homework-Scheduler
helps teachers set deadlines around student commitments. Bhilaipedia is a wiki
for IIT Bhilai.

heading: What projects are there for electronics students
content:
bhilaee-labs is a virtual lab platform for Electrical and Electronics
Engineering experiments. bhilaee-simulator is a browser-based circuit
simulator with DC, AC and transient analysis. FOSSI covers free open-source
silicon, EDA tools and chip design.

heading: What projects involve machine learning
content:
SmartTriage finds duplicate issues by semantic search and auto-assigns
reviewers from commit history. Photo-Sharing-App groups photos by face.
Smart-Cams adds computer vision to CCTV and mobile cameras. AI-Voice-Agent is
a voice agent that adapts to its user. Speech-Analyser helps improve English
fluency.

heading: What projects help with placements and careers
content:
The Centre-for-Career-Planning-and-Services-Portal links students with the
placement cell. career-scraper analyses career trajectories. Knowledge holds
career-planning resources. Interview-Preparation and GSoC_Proposals archive
preparation material and past proposals.

heading: What is canonforces
content:
canonforces is a Codeforces companion with a built-in IDE, real-time 1v1 DSA
battles and stat syncing.

heading: What infrastructure does OpenLake run
content:
Hub connects OpenLake apps and provides unified APIs. auth-kit provides single
sign-on, JWT access control and role management across the ecosystem. Infra
holds the automation, bots and configuration that keep things running. Bit is
a git server built from scratch for IIT Bhilai.

heading: What fun projects are there
content:
Virtual-IIT-Bhilai is a virtual campus game world built with Godot and
Node.js. WatchParty allows remote movie watching with shared chat. Quiz-App
runs real-time quizzes and polls with live leaderboards. Live-Score-App does
real-time sports scoring. Find-your-Cluster finds shared interests among peers.

heading: What was the most recent event
content:
A Hacktoberfest Hack Day, Durg x OpenLake, held on 10 October 2026 in L101 at
IIT Bhilai. It was an official MLH Hack Day run with Major League Hacking and
DEV, with DigitalOcean, and included a morning workshop, an afternoon build
session with mentors, and evening demos and judging.

heading: What workshops has OpenLake run
content:
Recent ones include an intro session in August 2026, FOSS Overflow in January
2026, a Linux installation workshop in October 2025, a Git and GitHub workshop
in August 2025, and a GSoC introduction in January 2025.

heading: Where is OpenLake based
content:
OpenLake is the open-source society of IIT Bhilai, in Chhattisgarh. Workshops
and events are usually held on campus, often in L101.

heading: Can I get OpenLake stickers
content:
Yes. The site offers free stickers, open to programmers anywhere, not only
IIT Bhilai students.

heading: What is FOSS United
content:
FOSS United is described by OpenLake as India's largest open-source ecosystem.
OpenLake promotes it from its home page.
